items.why: Opening sales is a business authorization, not a code change.
items.needed: A separate written decision to set sales enabled after the pricing and security gates are accepted.
items.prepared: isSalesEnabled is false. Checkout of a blocked price returns PRICE_POLICY_BLOCKED.
items.after: The sales gate can be reviewed. Incomplete prices remain rejected.

items.why: A cross-currency rate cannot be invented.
items.needed: The approved rate provider, the currency list, and the verification date.
items.prepared: Identity rates work. Every other pair stays FX_RATE_UNKNOWN.
items.after: Only a verified rate can enter recommendPrice.

items.why: The stored snapshot is not an official filing rate.
items.needed: A verified rate table and a licensed review before any return is filed.
items.prepared: Tax calculation returns VAT_UNVERIFIED. payTax stays HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED.
items.after: A verified amount can be passed as vatVerified. The software still does not file.

items.why: Real payment capture needs the owner's provider account.
items.needed: Provider approval and credentials outside the repository.
items.prepared: Capture returns PAYMENT_NOT_LIVE. Card numbers are rejected and not stored.
items.after: A human approval can be recorded. It still does not capture money until sales and the provider are separately enabled.

items.why: Purchases and labels need the owner's accounts.
items.needed: Supplier and carrier authorization. No credential should be pasted into chat.
items.prepared: Stock purchase and shipment functions return human-gate or blocked results.
items.after: Contract tests can be pointed at a sandbox the owner approves.

items.why: Publishing a listing requires the owner's marketplace accounts.
items.needed: Account authorization for Amazon, eBay, Kaufland, Allegro, bol.com, Cdiscount, OTTO, eMAG, and Skroutz.
items.after: Local simulators can be connected only after authorization.

items.why: A voice must not be cloned or presented as a live person without consent.
items.needed: Written consent and the approved voice asset for each speaker.
items.after: The local adapter can be configured. It still must not place a real call without a second approval.

items.why: Machine text and incomplete registers cannot be certified by software.
items.needed: Human translation review and official EU27 register extracts.
items.prepared: Translations stay UNREVIEWED. The register stays EU27_REGISTRY_INCOMPLETE.
items.after: Reviewed strings and quoted entities can replace the unknown fields.

items.prepared: No deploy, commit, or push was made.
items.after: A release can be prepared only after that approval.
